key_concepts: Ionic compounds form from cations and anions using the crisscross method
Chemical formulas and names of common ionic compounds
Acids have sour taste and pH below 7
Bases feel slippery or soapy and have pH above 7
Neutral solutions have pH equal to 7
Acid-base neutralization produces salt and water
Acids, bases, and salts form aqueous electrolyte solutions in water
Common acids include sulfuric, hydrochloric, acetic, citric, and carbonic acid
Common bases include sodium, calcium, magnesium, aluminum, and ammonium hydroxides
Common salts include sodium chloride, potassium sulfate, and lead nitrate
Indicators such as litmus paper, turmeric, and vanilla identify acidic, basic, or neutral
Antacids are bases that neutralize excess stomach acid
